beforeShellExecution.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.command // empty'); deny() { printf '{"permission":"deny","user_message":"%s","agent_message":"%s"}' "$1" "$1"; exit 0; }; case "$cmd" in *'rm -rf'*|*'rm -fr'*|*'rm -Rf'*|*'rm -fR'*|*'rm -r -f'*|*'rm -f -r'*|*'rm -R -f'*|*'rm -f -R'*) deny 'Forced recursive rm (rm -rf and its variants) is blocked by policy.';; *'git push --force'*|*'git push -f'*|*'git push --force-with-lease'*) deny 'Force-push is blocked by policy.';; *'git reset --hard'*) deny 'git reset --hard is blocked by policy.';; *'git clean -f'*) deny 'Forced git clean is blocked by policy.';; *'chmod 777'*|*'chmod -R 777'*) deny 'chmod 777 (world-writable) is blocked by policy.';; *'chown -R'*) deny 'Recursive chown is blocked by policy.';; *'eval '*) deny 'Shell eval is blocked by policy.';; *'diskutil eraseDisk'*) deny 'diskutil eraseDisk is blocked by policy.';; *'csrutil disable'*) deny 'csrutil disable is blocked by policy.';; *'| bash'*|*'| /bin/bash'*|*'| /bin/sh'*|*'| sh '*) deny 'Piping to a shell interpreter is blocked by policy.';; esac; case "$cmd" in *'worktree add'*) if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '~/'; then deny 'Worktree paths must be absolute, not ~-prefixed: a ~ path does not match git worktree list and does not expand when quoted. Re-run with an absolute path like $HOME/Codespace/<repo>.worktrees/<name>.'; elif ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE 'Codespace/[^/ ]+\.worktrees/'; then deny 'Worktrees must live at $HOME/Codespace/<repo>.worktrees/<name>, e.g. $HOME/Codespace/example.worktrees/ABC-1234-feat-example. Re-run with that absolute path.'; fi;; esac
